verdict.rationale: Gazebo Fuel is a first-party registry of reusable robot and environment models, including PR2, Pioneer2 DX, iRobot Create and TurtleBot. Developers can pull these models through a documented C++ client library and command-line tools, or by copying SDF snippets from a model's page into their own files. Gazebo libraries are also distributed as installable packages (gz-jetty metapackage, ROS vendor packages). Missing for 10: no evidence of a registry for reusable behavior or plugin modules (custom plugins must be developed), and no independent or hands-on corroboration of the Fuel workflow.
